note: url_embed renders plain URLs pasted into rich text (or Link fields) as oEmbed/Open Graph embeds via the `embed/embed` PHP library. Its two text filter plugin ids are `url_embed_convert_links` (bare URL -> <drupal-url data-embed-url="..."> tag) and `url_embed` (tag -> rendered embed HTML), both configured per text format under filter.format.<id>.filters.<plugin_id>.settings. The only global config object is url_embed.settings (keys facebook_app_id, facebook_app_secret), not shipped by default. The admin form route is url_embed.admin, gated by permission `administer url_embed`. A `url_embed` Link field formatter (LinkEmbedFormatter) renders Link field values the same way, with its own enable_responsive/default_ratio settings on the view-display component. Medium cases read back a known url_embed.settings value and a known filter setting on a namespaced url_embed_test text format; hard cases enable both filters on a namespaced url_embed_task text format, and switch a Link field's default-display formatter to url_embed with responsive wrapping, both verified against live config.

evals.prompt: The Drupal 11 contrib module url_embed lets editors paste a bare URL into a rich text field and have it render as an embed. Which of its two text filter plugins converts a plain pasted URL into a <drupal-url> embed tag in the first place, and what is that filter's exact plugin id?
evals.expected_output: The url_embed_convert_links filter (class ConvertUrlToEmbedFilter) scans the text for bare URLs and rewrites each one into a <drupal-url data-embed-url="..."></drupal-url> element. That tag is then rendered into actual embed markup by the separate url_embed filter, so both must be enabled (convert_links must run before url_embed in filter order).

evals.prompt: A Drupal 11 site has the url_embed module's code present but embeds are not rendering, and the module's install requirements check is failing. What third-party PHP library (give the Composer package name) does url_embed require to fetch oEmbed/Open Graph data, and which class does it check for?
evals.expected_output: url_embed requires the embed/embed (oscarotero/embed) Composer library. Both UrlEmbedInstallRequirements::getRequirements() and the legacy url_embed_requirements() hook check class_exists('\\Embed\\Embed') and raise an error requirement if it's missing; the url_embed service (Drupal\url_embed\UrlEmbed) wraps Embed\Embed::get() to perform the actual fetch.

evals.prompt: What Drupal permission does url_embed define, and what does it actually gate on the site?
evals.expected_output: url_embed defines exactly one permission, administer url_embed ('Administer the Url Embed module'). It gates the url_embed.admin route (/admin/config/media/url_embed), the settings form where the Facebook/Instagram App ID and App Secret used for oEmbed authentication are stored (config object url_embed.settings). It does not gate use of the filters or the CKEditor 5 embed dialog, which are controlled separately.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site already has a Facebook App ID configured for url_embed's oEmbed authentication (used for Facebook/Instagram embeds). Inspect the live url_embed.settings configuration and report the facebook_app_id value.
evals.expected_output: url_embed.settings.facebook_app_id is url_embed_known_fb_app_5551234 (readable via `drush cget url_embed.settings facebook_app_id`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format called url_embed_test with the url_embed filter enabled. Inspect its live configuration and report the configured default_ratio (the fallback embed aspect ratio percentage) for that filter.

On this Drupal site there is a text format url_embed_task that has both url_embed filter plugins present (url_embed_convert_links and url_embed) but disabled. Enable both filters on that text format so pasted URLs are converted to embeds and rendered. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In filter.format.url_embed_task, both the url_embed_convert_links and url_embed filter plugins have status: true (e.g. via the format's Manage filters UI, or FilterFormat::setFilterConfig('url_embed_convert_links', ['status' => TRUE, ...]) and the same for 'url_embed', then ->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Link field field_url_embed_task whose default display currently uses the plain 'Link' formatter. Change its default display to use url_embed's 'Embedded URL' formatter with responsive wrapping (enable_responsive) turned on, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_url_embed_task component has type: url_embed and settings.enable_responsive: true (e.g. set via Manage display, or EntityViewDisplay::setComponent('field_url_embed_task', ['type' => 'url_embed', 'settings' => ['enable_responsive' => TRUE, 'default_ratio' => '66.669']])->save()).
